info.title: idbseq
info.description: Increasing numeric ID sequences over HTTP/JSON. Every response uses the envelope `{ success, data, error, meta? }`. Error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED 400, UNAUTHORIZED 401, FORBIDDEN 403, PROTECTED_COLLECTION 403, NOT_FOUND 404, COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND 404, COLLECTION_EXISTS 409, SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED 409, REQUEST_TIMEOUT 408, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE 413, RATE_LIMITED 429 (with Retry-After), INTERNAL 500, and from `idbseqd console` only DATABASE_BUSY 503 (with Retry-After) and DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE 503. See docs/API.md.

get.summary: Readiness: the store is open and the server is not shutting down.

post.summary: Change the admin password. Revokes every session.
Sign in as the admin. Returns an opaque bearer token.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: wrong username/password or locked account

403.description: FORBIDDEN: no admin exists yet; run `idbseqd admin init`

post.summary:
Keep the current admin session alive: it now expires a full session TTL
from now, but never more than 12 hours after sign-in. The token is unchanged.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: API keys have no session to refresh

post.summary:
Create the admin from the one-time link `idbseqd` prints on a first start with
the console on, then sign in. Served only when the console is on.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: the password is too short

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: the setup link is invalid, used or expired

403.description: FORBIDDEN: an admin account already exists

200.description: A page of collections, sorted by name

delete.summary: Delete a collection and its counter. Requires `confirm` (query or body) equal to the name.

get.summary: The last issued ID and a preview of the next one.

post.summary: Issue the next ID, or a batch with `?count=n`.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of IDs (1–10,000 by default). Without it, the response is `{ "id" }`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key; a repeat returns the original IDs

200.description: `{ id }` without `count`; `{ first, last, count, step }` with it

post.summary: Move the counter. Requires `confirm` equal to the name; backwards needs `allow_rewind`.
Create an API key. The full key is in the response only.

CollectionDto.description: A collection as returned by the API.

key.description: The full key `idb_<id>_<secret>`. Shown only once.

oneOf.description: Every ID is on disk before it is returned.
`size` IDs are reserved on disk at a time; a crash leaves a gap, never a duplicate.

DurabilityDto.description: How a collection makes issued IDs durable.

EmptyEnvelope.description: A success with no data: `{ "success": true, "data": null, "error": null }`.

data.description: A collection as returned by the API.

key.description: The full key `idb_<id>_<secret>`. Shown only once.

mode.description:
`server` for `idbseqd`, `console` for `idbseqd console <file>` (no
accounts: the console signs in only through the link it printed).

data.description: A refreshed admin session: the same token, a later expiry.

items.description: A collection as returned by the API.

ErrorBody.description: The `error` member of a failed response.

mode.description:
`server` for `idbseqd`, `console` for `idbseqd console <file>` (no
accounts: the console signs in only through the link it printed).

allow_rewind.description: Required to move the counter backwards.

oneOf.description: The next ID to issue; default `start`.

SessionExpiryDto.description: A refreshed admin session: the same token, a later expiry.

SetupBody.description: First-run setup: the token from the link `idbseqd` printed and the new admin password.

Error429.description: Error envelope: RATE_LIMITED, with a Retry-After header in seconds

Error500.description: Error envelope: INTERNAL (generic message; details are logged)

bearerAuth.description: An API key `idb_<id>_<secret>` or an admin session token from `POST /v1/auth/login`.
